_meta.rule: Every annotation MUST be re-traced against the real handler before submission. MCP defaults are pessimistic, so explicit values are mandatory.
_meta.response_rule: Return only task-relevant fields; never session/trace/request ids, internal timestamps, credentials, or raw rows.

tools.name: search_evidence
tools.intent: Search the caller's own Evidence chain (read-only, bounded to caller tenant/subject server-side).
tools.internal_contract_caller: TODO(CODEX): resolve to versioned read contract via contracts/lumenis_adapter.py + evidence_api (no raw SQL)
tools.description_for_model: Search LUMENIS evidence records scoped to the authenticated workspace. Returns evidence summaries with stable ids; never returns raw collected payloads.

subject_id.description: validated server-side; client value is never trusted for authorization

tools.outputSchema: TODO(CODEX): define structured output (evidence id, title, time, source_status, snippet); REQUIRED for stable tools
tools.annotation_justification: Pure retrieval over a bounded private workspace; no external entity, no state change, safe to retry.

tools.name: query_metrics
tools.intent: Read already-computed canonical metrics (COMPUTE=read). Model must NOT recompute production metrics.
tools.description_for_model: Return canonical metric values already produced by LUMENIS for the authenticated workspace and time window.
tools.annotation_justification: Reads stored canonical results; bounded private domain; no mutation/recompute.

tools.name: get_case_insights
tools.intent: Read insights for an internal case the caller owns.
tools.description_for_model: Return structured insights for a case the authenticated user is authorized to view.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.intent: Compute a report from canonical data and return it. If it persists a draft it becomes a write — split accordingly.
tools.internal_contract_caller: TODO(CODEX): report_export read/compute contract; confirm whether it persists
tools.description_for_model: Generate a report from canonical data and return it to the conversation without sending externally.
tools.annotation_justification: VALID ONLY if stateless. If the handler writes a persisted draft/file, set readOnlyHint=false,idempotentHint=false and move to write phase. TODO(CODEX) confirm by tracing handler.

tools.name: create_action_plan
tools.intent: Create an action plan in the caller's PRIVATE workspace (additive write).
tools.description_for_model: Create a private action plan owned by the authenticated workspace.
tools.annotation_justification: Additive write inside a bounded private workspace (not destructive); idempotent via client-supplied key stored server-side; requires explicit user intent.

tools.name: update_internal_case
tools.intent: Update an owned internal case (bounded mutation).
tools.description_for_model: Update fields of a case the authenticated user owns. Cannot change ownership or cross workspace.
tools.annotation_justification: State-changing but bounded and non-destructive; optimistic-concurrency via expected_version; confirm before overwriting fields.

tools.name: send_or_publish_external
tools.intent: Send/publish to an external channel (open-world). Disabled by default; enable only after explicit product + legal approval.
tools.internal_contract_caller: TODO(CODEX): only after approval; must route through internal policy/guard, never auto-publish
tools.description_for_model: Preview and, only after explicit user confirmation, send content to an external channel.
tools.annotation_justification: Crosses the boundary to an external entity (openWorldHint=true even though not destructive). MUST show resolved content + target and require explicit confirmation/preview; never auto-send. Held back from first launch.
